chunk: _comment: "Index of canonical-model verticals. READ THIS INDEX FIRST to choose the right vertical, then load registry.json for the standard's record-type field mappings and the matching {yamlDir}/canonical-*.yaml files for the actual schemas. recordCount is the number of record types defined in registry.json for that vertical; yamlFileCount (when present) is the number of canonical-*.yaml schema files currently on disk under yamlDir. yamlDir is null when no YAML schemas have been authored for that vertical yet (registry standard exists, schemas pending)."
